MANDATORY T08 DELTA: Insert the FIRST COMPLETE UPPER RESIDENTIAL FLOOR beneath the central attic roof. Raise the main terracotta roof and its existing THREE-window dormer intact, and add a full-height continuous cream living floor with THREE large front windows and FOUR side windows below it. The final vertical sequence is: ground floor with original entrance porch and FOUR-ARCH side loggia; ONE complete new upper living floor with full-height walls; then the habitable sloping attic with its broad dormer. Keep the original low timber entrance-porch roof and long low side-loggia roof at ground-floor level. Preserve the front door/community mail niche and connected rear capacities. This first full upstairs floor must be clearly visible on front and side, not just a larger dormer. Fit whole taller asset with clear margins.

REFERENCE PRIORITY: image 4 (the accepted T01 asset) defines the exact family DNA, FRONT and shape language. Image 5, when supplied, is the accepted immediate predecessor. Images 1-3 are MATERIAL/PALETTE inspiration only; NEVER copy their whole buildings, props, layout or lighting. Render exactly the current tier described below, not the style-reference scene. Never add boxes, crates, loose props or extra symbols. All lamps OFF, all glass non-emissive, no glow. Thick rounded clean forms, broad painted color areas.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one final Meshy image-to-3D building reference for Weedtopia Inc / Burning Hills.
Subject: community residential building, T08_L200. Exact visible state: first complete upper storey.
Family DNA: soft gables, deep loggia, integrated community mail niche beside entrance. Function: community residential building.
Progression: Preserve the T01 family DNA and the previously accepted tier. Integrate previous functional capacity compactly upward and rearward, inside the reserved parcel. Current cumulative architectural milestones: repaired shelter with community mail niche; additional broad dwelling module; extend the existing entrance loggia sideways with two broad rounded bays; keep the front door fixed; rear family wing; add a large inhabited attic with a broad central dormer; the first complete upper floor comes at T08; second stepped residential wing; continuous broad community loggia; first complete upper storey. No separate freestanding buildings: all wings and modules are structurally attached.
Current residential height about 8.8m. Through T07 keep a single full ground floor; T05 adds an inhabited attic, T08 the first complete upper floor. Do not stretch doors or ceilings to fill the maximum family envelope.
Scale: maximum reserved parcel 16m local X by 16m local Z, maximum family height 38m. This reserved envelope is NOT a visible base. See asset_spec.de.md for this tier's approximate occupied dimensions; render the whole current object, not an empty full-size plot.
Front and camera: local +Y up, front facing +Z, front stays on the lower-left visible face of the image, local +X side on lower-right. Camera at local (+X,+Y,+Z), about 35 degrees elevated, near orthographic 3/4 front view. Never mirror. Ground-center pivot intent; future growth is upward and toward local -Z. The entry and delivery zones stay on +Z.
Materials: warm plaster, reclaimed wood, terracotta, oxidized copper; epoch treatment: warm plaster, reclaimed wood, sage enamel, first permanent service modules. Broad hand-painted color areas and large restrained wear patches. Rounded/beveled silhouettes, thick reconstructable parts, modular retro technology, one or at most two eventual material slots. Green glass must be thick and legible. At most one dominant botanical or grinder motif.
Reference input roles: Image 1 Reclaimed Green Haven gives warm rebuilt shapes and readability; image 2 Herbal Atom Age gives rounded enamel machines and copper/brass; image 3 Burning Hills Afterglow gives hopeful worldbuilding only, NOT its dusk lighting, environment or people. Additional inputs, when present: the family's accepted T01 geometry anchor, then its immediately preceding accepted tier. Preserve their family identity, front and proportions while making the specified large upgrade visible. For T00 use only the intact T01 as extra geometry reference. For T01 or T_FIXED only the three style inputs are supplied.
Composition: exactly one single complete freestanding asset, centered and grounded; square 1024x1024 or larger, generous 10 percent clear margin all around. Plain solid very light warm-gray/off-white background. Neutral even studio light; one soft contact shadow only. All geometry entirely visible.
Technical intent: stylized game-ready smart-topology, clean edges, minimal geometry; no floating parts. Attached architectural planting is allowed; no loose props. A park may contain its intrinsic bounded planted parcel, never a surrounding scenic diorama.
Exclude: people, characters, vehicles, conveyor belts, surrounding scene, landscape, city, unrelated buildings, loose props, diorama ground, text, readable signs, numbers, logos, watermarks, UI, weapons, gore, smoking, smoke, particles, thin antennae, tangled cables, clipped or cropped geometry, baked dramatic shadows, glows, fog or dusk color casts.
